Services.title: Services that make a difference
Services.description: We are committed to providing a comprehensive package of services carefully designed to exceed your expectations and ensure a smooth, comfortable, and safe rental experience.

dailyRental.title: Daily Rental
dailyRental.description: Flexible daily car rental options to meet your quick mobility needs, with a wide range of modern cars for an exceptional driving experience and competitive prices that suit your budget.

weeklyRental.title: Weekly Rental
weeklyRental.description: Enjoy peace of mind and driving for longer periods with weekly rental options, whether for business trips or family vacations, we provide you with fully equipped vehicles ready to go.

longTermRental.title: Long-term Rental
longTermRental.description: Programs specially designed for companies and individuals, providing high flexibility and reliability all year round with exclusive prices and comprehensive regular maintenance options for lasting comfort.

deliveryAndCollection.title: Delivery and Collection
deliveryAndCollection.description: We save your precious time with our professional vehicle delivery and collection service from and to your specified destination, whether at the airport, hotel, or your residence.

supportAndAssistance.title: Support and Assistance
supportAndAssistance.description: Our technical team is ready around the clock to provide technical support and roadside assistance in emergencies, ensuring your journey continues safely and peacefully.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.description: Learn about Rawaes Car Rental: our vision, mission, values, and branches in the Kingdom.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Rawaes Car Rental, Rental and Luxury Services

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be the leaders of our country in the rental sector and provide innovative services, with a view to the horizon for everyone eager for more.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We make a difference with global quality and a commitment to professional principles and ethics, and we work to raise the level of assets and support high efficiency.

values.title: Our Values
values.body: Putting principles and integrity at the forefront of everything we do, providing outstanding customer service, and striving for the best standards of quality and performance.

fields.title: Our Principles
fields.body: Dealing with accuracy, integrity, transparency, and professional behavior in all privileges, and meeting the customer's ambition with the highest standards of advanced quality and continuous development.

AboutPage.goalBody1: Providing exceptional services, fostering innovation, and continuously improving our offerings to stay ahead and adapt to trends and technologies for sustainable growth and profitability while maintaining ethical business practices.
AboutPage.goalBody2: While creating a positive and inclusive work environment that fosters collaboration, personal growth, making a positive impact on society, and contributing to the communities in which we operate.
AboutPage.branchesSubtitle: Our locations spread to serve you. Choose the appropriate branch and view its location on the map.
AboutPage.noBranches: There are currently no active branches. You can add branches from the dashboard.

Payment.title: Complete payment
Payment.introUnderReview: Your cash payment request has been recorded and is under review — our team will contact you shortly to confirm the booking by phone.
Payment.introCashConfirmed: Your booking is confirmed with cash payment — the amount is due on pickup or at the branch as agreed.
Payment.introCashSubmitted: Your cash payment request has been recorded — our team will follow up to complete the process.
Payment.introRefunded: The full amount has been refunded via {method}.
Payment.introPartialRefund: Part of the amount has been refunded via {method}.
Payment.introNoRefund: No amount is refundable under the cancellation policy.
Payment.introBalanceDue: Your booking was modified and an extension balance of {amount} SAR is due — choose a payment method to settle it.
Payment.introChooseMethod: Choose a suitable payment method and complete the process.
Payment.successBodyUnderReview: Thank you! Your cash payment request has been recorded. Our team will contact you shortly to confirm the booking by phone.
Payment.successBodyCashConfirmed: Thank you! Your booking has been confirmed by phone. The amount is due in cash on pickup or at the branch as agreed.
Payment.successBodyCashSubmitted: Thank you! Your cash payment request has been recorded.
Payment.successBodyRefundStatus: The payment status has been updated per the cancellation policy. For any questions, please contact our support team.
Payment.successBodyPaid: Thank you! Your booking is confirmed and our team will contact you shortly regarding delivery and any additional steps.
Payment.name: Name
Payment.noMethodsTitle: No payment methods are currently available
Payment.noMethodsBody: Please contact our booking team to complete the payment, or try again later once methods are enabled by the administration.
Payment.methodsHint: You can pay with Tabby, Tamara, a credit card, Apple Pay, or loyalty points. Provider integrations are added later without changing the booking flow.
Payment.balanceNote: Your booking is already paid — only the modification/extension difference is due. You may also pay it in cash to the branch staff on pickup.
Payment.methodTabbyHint: 4 interest-free monthly payments — you'll be redirected to Tabby for approval
Payment.methodTamaraHint: Instalments per Tamara's terms — integration to be enabled later
Payment.methodPointsHint: Deducted from your loyalty points balance — points system integration to follow
Payment.tabbyIneligible: Sorry, Tabby is unable to approve this purchase at the moment.
Payment.tabbyPanelBody: You'll be redirected to Tabby to choose an instalment plan and accept the terms. The amount shown is the total including VAT — with no interest or extra fees.
Payment.tamaraPanelBody: Once enabled, a Tamara session will open to complete the instalment plan per their policies. It can be combined with company offers later.
Payment.applePayHosted: You'll be redirected to the secure payment page to complete the transaction via Apple Pay. Requires Safari on an Apple device with a card added.
Payment.applePayMock: This is currently a test mode and the request is recorded as paid for testing.
Payment.pointsBody: Enter an optional note (for example your membership number or the points to use). The actual points system integration is added on the server later.
Payment.pointsNotePlaceholder: Example: use 5000 points from the loyalty programme
Payment.errCardExpiry: The card expiry date is invalid (MM/YY).
Payment.errCardHolder: The cardholder name is too short.
Payment.complianceNote: The current confirmation updates the request status in the system for testing. Tabby, Tamara, the bank gateway, Apple Pay and the points system are integrated at server level with full compliance (PCI-DSS) when going live.
Payment.totalsNote: The amount shown includes VAT. Nothing will be charged until you confirm the payment.
Payment.metaDescription: Choose a payment method and complete your car booking.
